messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Build radio buttons by raw HTML, how can I get the input of these buttons?
parts:
You can only access the "input" object from inside of a server function. If you want to separate the code for the observer out into a separate file, that's fine, but you have to create a function that creates the observer, then call that function from within the server function. The reason for this is that each input object belongs to a specific browser session, and the server function is invoked for each session as it starts up; so if you just try to access input from outside the server function, we don't know which input object you mean.

Also, I don't think that HTML will work unless you also wrap it in <div id="your_input_id", class="shiny-input-radiogroup">, and you can drop the "id" attribute from the individual radio buttons as you'll just use input$your_input_id to access the value.
